title: Quotinator Per-Source Title-Alias File
description: A minimal, hand-authored set of raw-(title,type) substitutions (#181) consulted before Source resolution runs, so a bundled source's own misspelled/inconsistent title or type resolves to the already-canonical Source instead of creating or matching a duplicate. One alias file per bundled source, referenced from that source's own manifest.json entry via sourceAliasFile.

aliases.description: Every raw-(title,type) substitution this file declares. Empty for a source with no known title/type inconsistencies.

title.description: The raw title as this bundled source file actually spells it (matched case-insensitively).

type.description: The raw type as this bundled source file actually carries it (matched case-insensitively).

canonicalTitle.description: The correct title to resolve/create the Source under instead.

canonicalType.description: The correct type to resolve/create the Source under instead.
